headline: Premise Health says an employee copied data on about 2.76 million people and that it was not a hack.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (4 Tier 1), 16 claims (15 Confirmed, 1 Not established), 7 questions. The insider cause is the company's own account; no outside review. Oregon lists breach dates Mar 26-30. HHS breach portal not readable. Privacy check done: employee not named.
author: Research agent
